event: Past the dead sentinel's rubble he goes through the arch, the core raised for its red light.
Beyond is a vast black shaft with no floor, cold air rising from below; a chip falls forever.

memory.fact: The Ascending Dark is bone-dry, smelling of dust and old grease.
The Ascending Dark is bone-dry, smelling of dust and old grease.
A fall down the Ascending Dark's shaft is always fatal.

event: Broken flights climb the wall, slabs rise and sink on a slow beat, a grey seam far above.

memory.fact: The Broken Flights lie in near-total darkness.
The Broken Flights lie in near-total darkness.

event: Something circles unseen in the gaps; at the first landing wait a lantern-bracket and oil.
At the lip he flicks tiny bolts of emberlight up the shaft, painting it spot by spot.

changes.note: Practising emberlight bolts from his own well and through the mace

event: From his hand, through the mace, through the core: he learns three ways to throw them.
The hunter comes; a bolt catches a long pale shape that flinches from the light.
Backed into the narrow entrance, he throws the core's last fire as one broad wave.

changes.note: The wave poured through his own fire as well as the core's

event: Caught in the open flame, the creature blackens and falls dead before a claw reaches him.
The Tower marks the kill: level 5.

changes.note: The Gloomward Stalker's death raises his level
Three attribute points come with the level

event: He peels its pale hide and works loose the two clouded lenses that were its eyes.

changes.note: Skinned from the dead stalker

make.title: Stalker eye-lens
make.description: A clouded crystalline lens, cold to the touch, that drinks light rather than throwing it back.

changes.note: Cut from the dead stalker's eyes

memory.fact: The Gloomward Stalker is dead, burned at the shaft's mouth and stripped of hide and eyes.

event: He carries the carcass down to the cistern; the brazier there is dead cold, its fuel gone.

changes.note: Hauling the carcass down the floors

event: On the first floor he scavenges a broken stool and dry debris: real fuel.
He lights it with the rotted rope as tinder and a seed of his own Ember.

changes.note: A seed of his own Ember lights the brazier
Foraging the first floor and hauling the fuel back up

event: Core, rivet and the re-bound mace go into the fire, each seeded, and begin to drink.
He sets one point each into Presence, Luck and Intellect.

changes.note: All three points spent
He sets a point into Presence
He sets a point into Luck
He sets a point into Intellect
The deeper well of a higher Intellect

event: He draws Cold Revenge's charge into himself: it numbs and stiffens, and sets nothing.

changes.note: The cold-burn of holding the opposite pole in his flesh
Threading the cold through himself
The numbing chill

event: He forges the hammer-head with the full rivet's charge, and the blows bind ember into it.
Without rest he finishes the head, binds the brazier-stand, and burns the cold out of the bar.

changes.note: Three bindings on the last of his focus
Forging and binding

event: He feeds the pyre and meditates until every iron thing is charged and he is whole.

changes.note: The cold-burn closes as he meditates
His focus rises to the brim
The ache goes out of his limbs

event: He takes Burning Anger apart and welds its haft to the ember rod, at last reaching white heat.
Around the core he layers rivet, brazier-stand and old head; a hammer-head caps the other end.

changes.from: A heavy mace of fused steel on an iron haft, warm with the Ember bound into it.
changes.to: A twin-headed maul of ember-bound iron, a living core clad in its head.
changes.note: He reforges the mace into a double-ended maul around the core

event: Smithing, Apprentice.

make.axis: The quality of the product: its integrity, its balance and how secure its joins are.

changes.note: Smithing is marked at Apprentice; level is as the page holds it, no prose shows it

event: A two-handed, double-ended maul with a sun in its head: the finest thing he has made.
He meditates full again as the maul drinks the last of the ember it can hold.
The lenses and river-stone go in his pockets; the stalker's hide he ties round his neck.

make.title: Stalker hide cloak
make.description: A pale stalker hide tied loosely round the neck, uncrafted and loose.

changes.note: He wears the stalker's hide as a rough cloak

event: He keeps the maul's name: Burning Anger. Still. Always.
At the first landing he fills the bracket-lantern with oil and lights it with a fingertip.

memory.fact: Past any lamp lit there, the Broken Flights' only light is the far grey seam.
Past any lamp lit there, the Broken Flights' only light is the far grey seam.

event: He leaps the broken flights, then rides the slabs on their beat, the fall breathing below.

changes.note: Ember to light the lantern
Leaping the gaps and the slabs

event: On a narrow ledge sits a long-dead climber; Alan takes his hooded lantern and lights it.

make.title: Hooded lantern (lit)
make.description: A hooded iron lantern, burning steady, throwing a directional beam.

changes.note: Taken from the dead climber on the ledge and lit with a touch of ember

memory.fact: The Moving Dark is the darkest part of the shaft, out of reach of the grey seam's light.
The Moving Dark is the darkest part of the shaft, out of reach of the grey seam's light.

event: Scratched by his shoulder: the thing at the top moves the stones; it sleeps in the chain.

memory.fact: The ledge message says "the stones do not move on their own. The thing at the top moves them."
The ledge message says "the stones do not move on their own. The thing at the top moves them."
The ledge message says the thing at the top sleeps in the chain and wakes near the grey light.
The ledge message says the thing at the top sleeps in the chain and wakes near the grey light.

event: Three days on the ledge; the weight is the whole of it, the drum, the catch that holds the—

memory.fact: The ledge message's writer spent three days on the ledge and could not get past the thing.
The ledge message's writer spent three days on the ledge and could not get past the thing.
The ledge message says "the weight is the whole of it, the chain and the drum it turns on".
The ledge message says "the weight is the whole of it, the chain and the drum it turns on".
The ledge message breaks off at "the catch that holds the—".
The ledge message breaks off at "the catch that holds the—".

event: Far above, where the slabs dock, the dark gathers into a mass too square and still.
He rides the slabs up until they dock against a stone gantry below the grey exit-stair.

memory.fact: The grey seam's light reaches the Headworks' gantry, dim but the best on the floor.
The grey seam's light reaches the Headworks' gantry, dim but the best on the floor.

event: An immense seated figure of stone and iron blocks the dock, the great chain wound at its waist.
His lantern beam finds a single fat iron pin across the drum: the catch that holds the weight.
Before it can wake he brings the maul down on the pin with all his fire and the core's.

changes.note: His ember and the core's poured into one blow
The climb and the full swing

event: The pin shears; the chain rips off the drum and the colossus comes apart from the waist.
The counterweight falls without a sound, and every slab below sinks once and stops.

changes.note: The Counterweight Colossus's fall raises his level
Three attribute points come with the level

event: From the broken warden he works free the winding-drum and a long length of the chain.

make.title: winding-drum core
make.description: A dense coil of tension-wound iron, humming faintly with a stored force.

changes.note: Salvaged from the broken Colossus

memory.fact: The Colossus lies in pieces on the Headworks' gantry, its winding-drum torn out.

event: He drags the salvage up the stilled slabs and through the grey seam: another floor beneath him.

changes.note: Hauling the drum and chain up the last rungs
